column1: #Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=It is more of a map than a guidebook, a map of the city center that shows the location of all the restaurants, bars, and hotels.
#Text=It is definitely a tourist guide to help you find places to stay, eat, and park.
#Text=There is the main street, La Rambla, so I think it is in Barcelona with the big square next to it with a fountain.
#Text=There are grid lines across the city with numbers at each small restaurant, so we can imagine that a legend is missing.
#Text=Apart from the restaurant and parking areas, there are also a few souvenir shops.
#Text=There is a theater to the west, a few tourist attractions, a park for children to the northeast, and to the northwest a wooded area next to the Flore Park Hotel.
